business_scope.primary_industry_name: Franchise Licensing and Syrups Supply Chain for Bubble Tea Chains

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law with English precedent; statutory law enacted by Bermudian Parliament; retains appeals to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: UK-Bermuda Double Taxation Arrangement (2019, as extended)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), as amended, Part II (Exempted Companies) and sections 4 (method of incorporation), 5 (memorandum), 7 (articles), and 14 (certificate of incorporation); supplemented by the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1990 and the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda, Ministry of Finance
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation, issued under the Companies Act 1981 based on the filed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed under the Companies Act 1981. Registry practice requires an authorized share capital of at least BMD 12,000 (approx. USD 12,000) to qualify for the standard incorporation fee; issued capital may be wholly unpaid until service of a call. For the first allotment, subscription funds are commonly placed in escrow at a Bermuda-licensed bank pending issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, with release only upon registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED, that the subscription to the authorized share capital as set out in the Memorandum of Association is hereby accepted and approved, and the named subscribers shall be recorded accordingly.
RESOLVED, that the address of the registered office service provider, as stated in the Memorandum, is adopted as the registered office of the Company in Bermuda, with all statutory notices to be served therein.
RESOLVED, that the subscribers or such persons named in the designation checklist be and are hereby elected and appointed as the first directors of the Company, and that the person named therein be appointed Secretary and Resident Director, each to act until the first annual meeting.
RESOLVED, that the directors and Secretary are authorized to complete all filings and to open corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Reservation of Proposed Exempted Company Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies (Company Name Clearance), Government of Bermuda
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed name for clearance through the Registrar of Companies' official online portal or by authenticated email from a licensed formation agent; pay the BMD 50 search fee; restricted words are checked against the Companies Act 1981 and the Business Names (Registration) Act 1990; receive a name clearance certificate valid for 90 days.
required_dossiers: Cover letter from licensed formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, confusingly similar, or contains prohibited words, submit one or more revised alternatives using the same clearance application within 14 days; the clearance fee generally is not refunded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum, Articles and Consent Forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and Bermuda-licensed Corporate Service Provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with sections 5 and 7 of the Companies Act 1981 and include necessary exempted-company clauses, permitted share classes, first director and subscriber provisions, and registered office address; arrange execution by at least one subscriber before a notary public; obtain subscriber consents and the resident representative acceptance (where applicable).
required_dossiers: Consent of each subscriber to serve as first director (Form 1)
Consent of Bermuda resident representative or secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend and re-execute the document if the Registrar objects to objects or capital structure; substitute corrected signature pages or execute a duplicate declaration of compliance; resubmit within ten days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Application for Incorporation and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance (Companies Registry Counter and e-Services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Memorandum, Articles, Form A (application for registration of an exempted company), and mandatory declarations; remit the BMD 1,000 government incorporation fee; the Registry will assign a batch number, verify name clearance, and conduct initial review under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2018.
required_dossiers: Sworn declaration of compliance under section 14 of the Companies Act 1981
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond to the Registrar's comment letter within 14 days; common cures include clarifying the registered agent's status, details of the lawful business purpose, or providing evidence on economic substance; failure to cure within the stated period causes rejection and fee forfeiture.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Appointment of Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the registered office address is deemed to be the address specified in the Memorandum, contingent on the registered office provider's consent, which must be filed and accepted; the company becomes a distinct legal person and may execute contracts.
required_dossiers: Registered office service provider's consent to act
Notice of registered office address (Form R-9)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical or jurisdictional errors, apply for an administrative rectification under the Registrar's misnomer procedure; no government fee is charged if requested within five business days of issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Share Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First directors of the exempted company with licensed company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or execute a unanimous written resolution to approve the share subscription list, formally adopt the registered office, appoint the first officers and secretary, approve the issue of share certificates, and adopt the company seal; thereafter update the statutory registers and execute the share register.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting or written resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointment is defective or a form is incomplete, ratify by subsequent board resolution and refile corrected forms within the 30-day grace period under the Companies Act 1981.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership Registration and Tax Exemption Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies and Bermuda Tax Commissioner (International Tax Administration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial beneficial ownership return with the Registrar within 14 days of incorporation; submit an application under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1990 to secure the statutory 25-year tax exemption from income taxes and capital taxes; deliver the economic substance declaration classifying the entity as a non-trading holding company if applicable.
required_dossiers: Exempted undertaking tax protection certificate application (Form TEP-1)
Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar or Tax Commissioner initiates an economic substance review, respond with board meeting minutes, physical and human resource evidence, and payroll records; if the tax exemption is denied, request an administrative review with the Ministry of Finance within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Business Licensing Authority, Ministry of Finance, and Department of Health, Environmental Health Section
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business License (Category 20 – Retail Food and Drink) under the Business Licenses Act 1981 and Food Establishment Permit under the Food Establishment Regulations 2004

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Bermuda Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C (Registration Certificate) – light industrial food-processing, warehousing and syrup formulation; no full EIA report is required if production volume is under 1,000 liters per day. Pure franchise-licensing office activity is exempt from EIA registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with the Sewerage and Drainage Regulations 1979 (CBOD ≤ 20 mg/L, TSS ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6.5–8.5); indoor and process VOC emissions must not exceed 20 ppm at boundary; all effluents from cleaning operations must be routed to a licensed waste transporter; no undiluted chlorinated solvents or grease residue may enter storm drains; stack height and discharge opacity for boilers limited to No. 2 smoke chart.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate under the Bermuda Fire Safety Act 1999, including sprinkler drawings, evacuation signage, and storage limits for flammable syrups; structural load inspection for mezzanine or bottling areas by the Department of Planning and Building Control; occupational safety clearance for kitchen and packaging workstations under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1996, including ventilation, guarding, and employee sanitization protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Tax Authority (Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance) and the Bermuda Registrar of Companies. Online portal: https://www.gov.bm/taxation (Bermuda Government Taxation Portal).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity incorporating a Bermuda Exempted Company files an application with the Bermuda Registrar of Companies. Upon incorporation, the company receives a Certificate of Incorporation. Bermuda does not levy corporate income tax, so no corporate TIN is issued for income tax purposes. If the company engages Bermuda employees, it must register for payroll tax and obtain a Payroll Tax Account Number from the Tax Commissioner. If importing goods, it obtains an importer code from Bermuda Customs. A Tax Exemption Certificate can be obtained under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 to confirm exemption from future Bermuda taxes for up to 50 years.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Bermuda Exempted Company is outside Bermuda income tax; can hold a Tax Exemption Certificate guaranteeing no income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on dividends for up to 50 years).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Bermuda has no check-the-box regime. An Exempted Company may elect for 'Non-Resident' status from the Bermuda Monetary Authority for exchange control purposes. A Tax Exemption Certificate may be applied for electively to grandfather the absence of future Bermuda income and capital taxes. Hybrid mismatch outcomes are governed by UK/OECD rules only and are not addressed through Bermuda statutory elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT or GST in Bermuda; indirect taxes are limited to import customs duties under the Customs Act 1942, payroll tax on Bermuda-sourced remuneration, and social insurance contributions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: there is no VAT/GST regime and therefore no economic turnover threshold for indirect tax registration. Customs duty registration occurs upon first importation; payroll tax registration is required as soon as Bermuda employees are engaged, without a minimum payroll exemption threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance mandate exists. Bermuda Customs uses an electronic customs management system (Asycuda World) for import/export declarations and duty payments, but there is no digital stamping, invoice clearance, or continuous transaction control regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Bermuda imposes no VAT or GST, so there is no zero-rating mechanism. Exports of goods leave Bermuda outside the scope of customs duty, and offshore services supplied by a Bermuda Exempted Company (including franchise royalties and supply chain services to global boba tea franchisees) are not subject to Bermuda tax. No VAT recovery is available or required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Bermuda Customs Export Entry, where physically exporting from Bermuda)
Certificate of Origin (if required by destination jurisdiction)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Since there is no VAT zero-rating or refund regime, no VAT clawback penalties apply. Customs penalties apply for export misdeclaration under the Customs Act 1942. For tax-exempt status, the primary audit threat is economic substance non-compliance: penalties under the Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2018 include substantial fines, reporting to the EU Code of Conduct Group, and the risk of losing the tax-exemption protection.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA) — the central bank, currency board administrator, integrated financial services regulator, licensing authority for banks and foreign-exchange-control administration under Bermuda's Exchange Control Act 1972 and the Banking Act 1998. For clearing paths using UK payment systems or the Bank of England's real-time gross settlement infrastructure, the Bank of England acts as the settlement authority for GBP-leg transactions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is backed one-for-one by US dollars and pegged to the USD, making the currency de facto fully convertible for current and capital account transactions. A Bermuda Exempted Company that obtains non-resident designation under the Exchange Control Act 1972 may hold USD, GBP, EUR, BMD and other currencies freely, open multi-currency accounts, contract offshore and remit dividends, franchise royalties, capital injections, intercompany loans and liquidation proceeds without BMA exchange-control permission. The only convertibility hurdle arises if treasury activity causes the exempted company to be characterised as Bermuda-resident, in which case the BMA can require conversion of non-BMD revenue into BMD and impose restrictions on capital outbound flows; this is avoided by maintaining the non-resident certificate and furnishing bank-to-BMA consents signed at account opening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For Bermuda-resident businesses, foreign-currency export proceeds must generally be surrendered to an authorised bank within 180 days of receipt, with a mandatory conversion ratio of 100% of gross export receipts into BMD/USD at the official peg. For the target Bermuda Exempted Company structured as a non-resident entity and holding no Bermuda local trade or sale of goods within Bermuda, the surrender obligation does not apply: 100% of export proceeds, franchise royalties and syrup supply-chain receipts may be retained in foreign currency and deployed directly through the corporate treasury. The non-resident status must be re-confirmed in BMA annual returns and in each bank's compliance attestation; failure to maintain that designation would trigger the 180-day surrender window and mandatory full conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multi-Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Corporate Account, FX Settlement Account and Merchant Clearing Account
Local Operational Account and Trust Escrow Account
Private Treasury Account and Investment Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a secondary disbursement and receivables-collection rail, but Low as the sole or primary treasury account of the Bermuda Exempted Company. Regulated foreign EMIs such as Wise, Revolut Business, MultiPass and Ebury may be used lawfully for downstream GBP, EUR or USD operating settlements where they hold local e-money, payment-institution or banking licences, provided those licences are active in the underlying franchisee country. The critical legal constraint is Bermuda's Banking Act 1998, which prohibits unlicensed entities from carrying on deposit-taking business in or from Bermuda; an offshore EMI without a BMA banking licence cannot hold Bermuda-source corporate deposits or present itself as a Bermuda bank. Therefore, the blueprint is to keep the regulated legal-entity treasury at HSBC or Butterfield in Bermuda and integrate EMIs only as specialised disbursement rails for designated operating jurisdictions outside Bermuda.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda statutes do not explicitly require directors to appear in person, but every licensed Bermuda bank's AML/KYC procedure mandates a live identity-verification step for all directors and authorised signatories. In practice, directors with an existing relationship at HSBC Bermuda or Butterfield can be onboarded remotely via certified video conference; new non-resident directors who lack a prior banking nexus, who are PEPs, or who hold ownership through a trust or offshore structure must attend an in-person interview at a designated bank office, commonly located in Bermuda, London, New York, Singapore or Hong Kong. The bank must complete a signed-board-resolution verification, notarised passport copies, a completed BMA declaration, and a company-beneficial-ownership schedule before any transaction limits are lifted; failure to meet this mandate triggers a 90-day hold and possible initial account rejection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of franchise capital: very large upfront franchise fees and syrup supply pre-payments from operators in China, the United States and continental Europe.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver signed master franchise and joint-venture agreements, complete commercial and pro-forma invoices for syrup and equipment export, customs/freight bills, audited or reviewed financial statements for the exempted company, a ledger of historic and projected royalty income, formal source-of-wealth declarations for all shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, and a documentary flow chart showing how each major receivable is contractually derived from store-level sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership opacity: exempted company formed with bearer shares, nominee directors, offshore trusts or a partially disclosed beneficial-ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the BMA- and bank-standard corporate register, a notarised beneficial-ownership register listing every natural-person ultimate beneficial owner, the Bermuda Registrar of Companies current official search report, a share-transfer restriction statement certified by the registered agent, a copy of the declaration of trust if any trust layer exists, and written surrender of any bearer share rights to prevent the bank from escalating the structure to high-risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payment patterns that appear as lumpy outbound royalty remittances to a UK parent followed by immediate onward wires to franchisee jurisdictions that may include sanction-sensitive countries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Adopt a controlled payment-policy framework with pre-approved counterparties, SWIFT payment purpose codes and exact banking-mandate authority. Submit the board-approved treasury policy, bank mandates and committee authorisation resolutions, granular franchisee sanctions and adverse-media screening reports, OFAC/UN/EU/UK sanctions compliance certifications, and an ongoing audit trail of all sanctioned-jurisdiction clearance decisions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party merchant-processing flows: large numbers of local bubble-tea point-of-sale collections are aggregated by payment service providers and wired into the Bermuda treasury without a bankable receivable trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish merchant-acquirer statements, PSP referral or processing contracts, POS settlement reports, a royalty calculation workbook linked to store-level gross sales, period-end bank reconciliation reports matching daily settlement files to the single SWIFT credit, and audited intercompany royalty certificates confirming that the payments represent genuine franchise activity rather than unregulated deposit-taking.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound shareholder capital, equity subscriptions, convertible loan advances and intercompany treasury top-ups should arrive in USD via SWIFT MT103 credit transfer, with the payment narrative stating 'Equity subscription under Bermuda Companies Act 1981' or 'Intercompany Treasury Loan' as applicable. The receiving bank should be HSBC Bank Bermuda Limited or Butterfield, using their New York USD correspondent channels (Citibank or JPMorgan) for same-day clearing. The remitter shall include a matchable reference equal to the BMA corporate file number and the board-approved capital-injection reference. For funds originating from the UK, convert GBP to USD at the receiving bank only once to avoid double FX cost; prohibit crypto, third-party personal accounts or prepaid cards. The bank will require the non-resident exempted-company declaration and a board resolution to classify the funds as paid-in capital or intercompany debt for BMA, FATCA and CRS reporting consistency.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for syrup procurement, equipment supplies, franchise royalty distributions and intercompany obligations shall clear through standard SWIFT MT103/MT202 wire transfers for high-value and time-critical payments, and through commercial letters of credit governed by UCP 600 for bulk ingredient or machinery purchases from new or first-time Asian and US suppliers. Regular small-ticket franchisee fees may be batched through local ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments or merchant PSP settlement systems, then swept to the Bermuda USD treasury account in one daily wire. All trade disbursements must mirror an invoice, transport document or royalty certificate; no cash transactions above regulatory thresholds and no cryptocurrency settlement should be used for trade payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BMD deliverable forward contracts, economically covered by the 1:1 peg, limited to specific Bermudian-dollar cash needs.
GBP/USD outright deliverable forward contracts up to 12 months for UK parent dividend and royalty remittances.
EUR/USD deliverable forward contracts executed at the Bermuda bank's dealing desk for European franchisee licensing revenue.
CNY/USD non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts for Chinese franchise and syrup-supplier flows where onshore CNY delivery is restricted.
PHP/USD, VND/USD and IDR/USD non-deliverable forward contracts for South-East Asian franchise and supply-chain receipts where local currencies are non-fully convertible.

USD/GBP and USD/EUR cross-currency interest rate swaps and cross-currency basis swaps to hedge long-term intercompany loans, capital injections or acquisition funding, subject to the bank's ISDA 2002 or approved local derivatives documentation and board-approved hedging policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return / Confirmation of Company Details under the Bermuda Companies Act 1981
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days following the anniversary of incorporation; first filing is due on the first anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts statutory late penalties; continued default may lead to a notice of intended strike-off and eventual administrative dissolution of the exempted company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Payment for Exempted Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies / Bermuda Government Treasury
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January for the standard fee cycle, with pro-ration in the year of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid annual fees accrue monthly arrears penalties and interest; prolonged non-payment can result in suspension of standing, enforcement action, and strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Declaration / ESR Return (if relevant activity is carried on)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Bermuda Economic Substance Authority)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the relevant financial year; a 31 December year-end requires filing by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the ESR Return exposes the company to monetary penalties, increased regulatory scrutiny, and potential mandatory disclosure, with no immediate strike-off but substantive compliance consequences.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to a standard Bermuda exempted company solely on the basis of turnover, assets, or shareholding. A compulsory audit arises only where the entity is regulated under Bermuda's banking, insurance, or investment funds legislation, or where the board or shareholders voluntarily adopt audit under the bye-laws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Bermuda does not prescribe a single local GAAP for exempted companies. Financial statements are ordinarily prepared under IFRS, or under US GAAP where appropriate for cross-border franchise reporting; accounts need not be filed publicly with the Registrar except in regulated circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Bermuda maintains no public UBO register for standard exempted companies. The company must maintain an internal beneficial ownership register and keep it accurate and current upon any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership; the register is made available to competent authorities on lawful request, and no separate annual UBO confirmation filing is required for an ordinary exempted company.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 1,500 - 3,500 USD per annum for registered office, corporate agent, and secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 5,000 - 12,000 USD per annum if a voluntary independent audit is engaged; no mandatory audit fee applies for a standard exempted company

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% under the standard Bermuda exempted company regime (no income, corporation, capital gains, or withholding tax); a 15% Bermuda corporate income tax (CIT Act 2023) applies only to constituent entities of in-scope multinational enterprise groups with annual consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million (effective for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2025). This boba tea franchise entity is subject to the 0% regime unless its ultimate parent group crosses the EUR 750 million threshold.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero effective tax rate on franchise royalties, syrup supply-chain trading profits, and passive investment income. No statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions are necessary because profits are not taxed. In-scope CIT groups may claim the OECD GloBE substance-based income exclusion of 10% of eligible payroll costs plus 8% of eligible tangible asset carrying value during the transition period (falling to 5% and 5% after the 10-year transition period).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2 — Economic Substance Declaration (Economic Substance Act 2018 and Economic Substance Regulations 2018); filed electronically through the Bermuda Companies e-Registry (BizReg / BEX portal) administered by the Ministry of Finance and the Registrar of Companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months after the end of the exempted company's financial period. For a 31 December year-end: no later than 30 June of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted company name, company registration number, date of incorporation, registered office address, registered agent, and CIT registration status (where applicable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the name and contact details of the Bermuda-licensed corporate services provider; non-resident directors and shareholders need not be listed individually, but beneficial owners must be disclosed to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick all relevant activities performed in the financial period: IP business, distribution and service business, financing and leasing, banking, insurance, fund management, headquarters, shipping.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare 'intellectual property business' for franchise trademark and brand licensing and 'distribution and service business' for the syrup supply-chain trading; both categories must be reported where the entity licenses the boba tea brand and also trades goods with related franchisees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Specify the location and substance of CIGA: strategy and brand management, franchise negotiation and contract execution, supply-chain procurement, invoicing and treasury, risk management, QA and recipe standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If CIGA are performed by employees of a related franchise company outside Bermuda, identify the outsourcing arrangement and confirm CIGA provision; avoid leaving this box empty because it triggers an automatic substance assessment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D — Substance Metrics (employees, premises, expenditure)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of full-time Bermuda employees, annual payroll, physical office footprint, total operating expenditure, and revenue attributable to each relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident managers are not counted toward Bermuda substance; provide locally bankrolled payroll and lease figures because they will be exchanged with the UK HMRC and other treaty partners upon request.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or late filing: fixed penalty BMD 39,000 plus BMD 1,000 per day of continuing default. Incorrect or false declaration: BMD 25,000 and up to 5 years imprisonment. Failure to satisfy the economic substance requirement: BMD 250,000 per financial period, daily penalty BMD 1,000, and potential winding-up.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Certificate of Compliance (Form CoC) under section 274 of the Companies Act 1981; filed through the Registrar of Companies' BizReg electronic filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 30 June in each year (for newly incorporated exempted companies, within 30 days after the first anniversary of incorporation or by 30 June following the first financial year-end, whichever applies).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the Bermuda exempted company as set out in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal name must match the registered name; an English-language commercial name used by non-resident franchisees has no effect on this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique company number assigned by the Bermuda Registrar of Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain the number from the registered agent; all tax and banking forms reference this number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Bermuda maintained by a licensed corporate services provider.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot be a foreign franchise or head-office address; the Bermuda registered agent's office is mandatory and must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signed declaration by the managing director or authorized persons that the company has satisfied all obligations under the Companies Act 1981 for the preceding year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The declaration is made on behalf of the board, including non-resident global franchise directors; a knowingly false declaration triggers director liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of BMD 150 per day; continued default beyond 3 months results in compulsory striking-off and dissolution with vesting of assets in the Crown; directors of a struck-off company may be barred from managing Bermuda entities without leave of the court.
